content.rendered:
Pre-orders for the 2021-2022 SCS Yearbook are now open! You can pre-order now until Thursday May 6th. After May 6th, you can still order a yearbook for immediate order (immediate orders will be shipped to the home address). E-yearbooks are free!

Online orders only. We cannot accept checks or cash.

Please purchase from the correct yearbook when ordering (K-5 or 6-8). Refunds will not be available.

Shop now here: https://store.shopyearbook.com/SCS2022

Yearbooks will be shipped to the school with pre-orders. Immediate orders will be shipped to your home address.

Contact Shannon Peterka at speterka@sherwoodcharterschool.org with questions.
